runs.label: artifact-checks
runs.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,re,sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('build/uc001-priority5v-postcode-format')
json_files=list(p.rglob('*.json'))
for file in json_files: json.loads(file.read_text())
receipt=json.loads((p/'verification.json').read_text())
audit=json.loads((p/'preservation-audit.json').read_text())
assert receipt['phase']==3 and receipt['status']=='in-progress'
assert Path('docs/TASKS.md').read_text().startswith('PHASE: 3\nSTATUS: in-progress\n')
for name,expected in audit['changes_sha256'].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,name
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(receipt['prerequisites']['retained_format_basis']['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==receipt['prerequisites']['retained_format_basis']['sha256']
for name in ('commands.json','preservation-audit.json','git-status.txt','git-diff-check.txt'):
 assert (p/name).is_file(),name
assert Path(receipt['actual_browser_journey']['artifact']).is_file()
assert (Path('docs')/'../build/uc001-priority5v-postcode-format/verification.json').resolve().is_file()
assert not list(p.rglob('*.har')) and not list(p.rglob('*trace*.zip'))
secrets=set()
for color in ('red','green'):
 with sqlite3.connect(f'build/test-only/uc001-priority5v-format-{color}.sqlite3') as connection:
  for row in connection.execute('SELECT submission_key_digest,proof_binding,payload_digest FROM search_request'):
   secrets.update(row)
text_files=[file for file in p.rglob('*') if file.is_file() and file.suffix in ('.json','.txt','.md','.py','.ts')]
leaks=[str(file) for file in text_files if any(value in file.read_text() for value in secrets)]
assert not leaks,leaks
result={'JSON_files_parsed':len(json_files),'receipt_links_exist':True,'six_file_hashes_match_final_audit':True,'retained_source_hash_matches':True,'phase_3_in_progress':True,'actual_persisted_browser_submission_digests_or_bindings_in_text_artifacts':0,'trace_HAR_exports':0,'new_text_artifacts_checked':len(text_files)}
(p/'artifact-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
PY
